The "Malformed row" error always pointing to row 1 suggests the upload process encounters a format mismatch right at the start of the file. Since you mention that the columns appear correct and it coincides with your finance team switching to a new export tool, one possibility is that the new export might have changed file encoding, added a BOM (Byte Order Mark), or altered newline characters. These changes can make the system misinterpret the header row length.

Could you check if the exported file from the new tool differs in encoding or contains any hidden characters before the first row? Also, verifying if the file uses commas, semicolons, or tabs as column separators would help, as the import parser expects a specific delimiter consistent with past imports.

If you can share a sample of an affected file (without sensitive data), it would help us investigate further.
